create_llm_error_handling_middleware: create an LLMErrorHandlingMiddleware instance that wraps model calls with retry, backoff, and circuit breaker logic
wrap_model_call_retry_transient_errors: wrap a synchronous model call handler with retry on transient LLM errors and exponential backoff
awrap_model_call_retry_async_errors: wrap an async model call handler with retry on transient LLM errors and exponential backoff
classify_llm_error_type: classify an LLM exception as retriable or non-retriable based on status codes, error messages, and error codes
extract_retry_after_delay_ms: extract the Retry-After header value from an exception response and convert it to milliseconds for retry delay
